title: The Bell Below
introNarration: Alder sets the tuning fork on the blotter and waits until you meet his good eye. "I am trusting you with the first honest question this school has asked in a long time. A deep bell sounds under our feet. The old abbey bell is gone — we have an empty frame in the Clock Tower to prove it. I will not invent a cause from a rumour. I need you to examine three places and come back with facts: the Empty Bell Frame, the Bell Ledger in the Archive Cellar, and the Listening Stone in the Quiet Chapel. Then talk alder here. The Collegium is listening through you."
reminderNarration: Alder does not raise his voice. He does not need to. "Down to the Great Hall. East from the North Quad for the Clock Tower. North from Library Stacks for the Archive Cellar. West from the Herb Garden for the Quiet Chapel. Examine the Empty Bell Frame, the Bell Ledger, and the Listening Stone. Then return and talk alder. Type quests if you lose the list. I asked you because I need a Collegian who will look before they guess."
completionNarration: You lay out what you found: an empty frame that still pulses, a keeper's record that the bell was taken, and three slow beats in the chapel root. Alder rests the fork against the oak. For a moment a deeper note answers it. "The wood remembers that welcome. The bell is gone, and the living timber still carries the sound. That is the true part. What first woke it is a later question. You did this school a service. I will not forget who brought me facts."

objectives.label: Examine the Empty Bell Frame in the Clock Tower. Alder sent you to prove the bell is gone. Type east from the North Quad.
Examine the Bell Ledger in the Archive Cellar. The keepers wrote down what was taken. Type north from Library Stacks.
Examine the Listening Stone in the Quiet Chapel. Feel whether the pulses match the tower. Type west from the Herb Garden.
Bring Alder the three facts in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall.
